overview.minides: India's original premium compact SUV — iconic seven-slot grille, 170 PS 2.0L Multijet II diesel, Jeep Active Drive 4x4 with Selec-Terrain, 10.25-inch Uconnect 5, panoramic sunroof, Level 2 ADAS, and a 5-star Global NCAP rating.
overview.description: The Jeep Compass is India's definitive premium compact SUV, first launched in 2017 and updated with a major facelift in 2021. In India, it is offered exclusively with the 2.0-litre Multijet II diesel engine producing 170 PS and 350 Nm, paired with either a 6-speed manual (FWD) or a 9-speed automatic (FWD or 4x4). The 4x4 system — Jeep Active Drive — comes with a Selec-Terrain dial offering Auto, Snow, Sand, and Mud modes plus a Rock mode on the Trailhawk (which was discontinued). The lineup spans Sport, Longitude, Limited, Model S, Nighteagle, and limited-run editions. Features across the range include 10.25-inch Uconnect 5 with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto (higher variants), 10.25-inch digital cluster, panoramic sunroof (Limited and above), Level 2 ADAS suite, heated front seats, a 9-speaker Alpine audio system, and a 5-star Global NCAP rating. The Compass continues to command a strong following for its authentic Jeep design, robust build, strong diesel performance, and best-in-class 4x4 capability among genuine Jeeps sold in India at this price point.
